_comment: Config for scripts/audit-we-closing-dates.js. Edited by hand; not auto-generated. West End analogue of data/closing-date-audit-config.json.

urlOverrides._comment: show.id -> booking URL override, when SERP discovery (data/westend-slug-map.json) picks the wrong page or a show has no westendtheatre.com presence but a good officialUrl/other booking page exists.

openRunSkip._comment: Open-run West End long-runners (opened pre-2018, no stored closingDate) with no announced closing horizon — the exact class of show most likely to produce a spurious anchored-date match on ordinary prose (no real 'booking until' statement exists to find). Mirrors data/closing-date-audit-config.json's openRunSkip. Remove an entry once the show announces a close — the audit will then surface a NEW_CLOSING candidate.

ambiguousAllowlist._comment: Shows where stored closingDate is human-verified correct but the booking page's window cuts off earlier. Same self-cleaning allowlist pattern as data/closing-date-audit-config.json.
